name: Thank You Email AI
tagline: Writing a thank-you email after an interview sounds simple, but most people get stuck
description: Writing a thank-you email after an interview sounds simple, but most people get stuck. Generic templates feel impersonal, and AI tools often take multiple prompts to get something usable. This tool is designed just for that moment. It turns your interview conversation into a clear, natural follow-up in seconds—no prompt engineering, no awkward tone.
